errors.text_span: The chart is divided into 2 main categories and further sub-categories, totaling 18 slices.
errors.evidence: The figure is a sunburst/pie chart with many more than 18 visible segments; counting the visible outer and inner segments yields far more than 18 slices.

errors.text_span: The two main categories are "Abusive" (teal) occupying roughly 55% and "Not Abusive" (yellow) occupying approximately 45%.
errors.evidence: The inner ring shows Abusive taking a little over half, closer to about 56–57%, and Not Abusive closer to about 43–44%, not 55/45 exactly.

errors.text_span: Under "Abusive", the sub-categories include "Other Negative" (around 17%), "Political Negative" (about 17%), "Racial Negative" (approximately 3%), "Sexist Negative" (around 3%), and "Mixed" (less than 1%).
errors.evidence: These are not single subcategories. The chart shows separate hierarchical labels: Abusive -> Other -> Negative, Abusive -> Political -> Negative, Abusive -> Racial -> Negative, Abusive -> Sexist -> Negative, and Abusive -> Religious -> Negative/Mixed. The description collapses the hierarchy into combined labels that do not exist as shown.

errors.text_span: Under "Not Abusive", the sub-categories are "Other Positive" (around 15%), "Neutral" (approximately 10%), "Political Positive, Negative, Mixed, Neutral" (around 8%), "Religious Positive, Negative, Racial, Sexist" (about 8%), and "Negative, Positive, Mixed, Neutral" (around 4%).
errors.evidence: The outer segments are arranged hierarchically and do not form combined labels like "Political Positive, Negative, Mixed, Neutral" or "Religious Positive, Negative, Racial, Sexist". The chart shows separate branches under Not Abusive, including Other -> Positive/Neutral/Negative/Mixed and Political -> Positive/Negative/Mixed, plus Religious -> Positive/Negative/Mixed/Neutral, etc.

errors.text_span: The chart does not include a legend, and the labels are placed directly on the slices.
errors.evidence: While there is no conventional legend, the figure also has a central label and hierarchical labels placed on ring segments rather than only on slices; this phrasing is somewhat imprecise but not wholly wrong.
The description does not mention the hierarchical sunburst/polar structure with multiple concentric rings, which is a key visual feature of the figure.
The description omits that some very small outer slices are present and that the labels are rotated/angled to fit the ring segments.
